Developed a Spring Boot-based web application to manage fields, irrigation schedules, users, and water logs using REST

Fitness Tracker December 2025 
Developed a full-stack Fitness Tracker application using MERN stack with secure user authentication and dynamic 
dashboard. Designed REST APIs for workout and calorie tracking, integrated MongoDB for data storage, and 
implemented responsive frontend using React for real-time progress monitoring. ReactJS, Node.js, NestJS 
(Microservieces), MongoDB 
 
 
Campus Pollution Monitor December 2025 
Developed a real-time Air Quality Monitoring and Prediction web application that tracks and visualizes environmental 
pollution data across regions in Tamil Nadu. The platform displays key air quality parameters such as PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, 
SO₂, O₃, CO and noise pollution levels (dB) with interactive charts and maps. It incorporates AI-powered prediction 
models to forecast future air and noise pollution trends and offers a live analytics dashboard for users to observe current 
environmental conditions. The system includes user authentication (login/signup) and is powered by cloud backend 
services for real-time data updates and machine learning integration.
